talking_points: Satya Nadella is betting that selling AI by the token, not the seat, can turn Microsoft into a true AI leader.
South Korean banks are reeling from a wave of AI-assisted hacking that exposed how far financial cyber defences lag behind attackers.
SpaceX's blockbuster IPO and a flurry of billion-dollar robotics and industrial deals show investors are still piling into anything tagged 'AI' or 'physical AI'.
